name: newera
label: Binned NewEra (PHOENIX) tables for the hot-star grid
contents: prepare_newera / bin_rf_standalone .npz (flux table + I(mu) profile per model)
notes: Scanned by sed.NewEraGrid.scan: files are keyed by (T_eff, log g, [M/H]); the finest wavelength step wins when several ranges exist.

Directory search order: $HBTSIM_NEWERA_DIR, then this `path` relative to the current directory, then <data_dir>/newera ($HBTSIM_DATA_DIR or the user cache). `hbtsim data fetch` downloads from `remote.base_url` ($HBTSIM_DATA_URL overrides) using its manifest.json; HBTSIM_AUTO_FETCH=1 or --fetch pulls missing tables on demand.
Provenance of the tables: the NewEra project handoff (NERSC project `newera`, /global/cfs/projectdirs/newera/binned).
